# Carlos García - Senior Infrastructure, DBA & Cloud Engineer

> Portfolio and technical profile of Carlos Javier García Contreras (goldengaco).

## Summary
Carlos García is a Senior Systems Administrator, Database Administrator (DBA), and Cloud/DevSecOps Engineer with over 7 years of experience in enterprise infrastructure, high availability (HA), disaster recovery (DRP), and system automation.

## Core Technical Skills
- **Operating Systems & Cloud**: Linux (RHEL, Ubuntu, Debian), Windows Server, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), MuleSoft CloudHub, Docker.
- **Database Administration (DBA)**: PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, MariaDB, IBM Informix, IBM Netezza, SQLite, DuckDB. Performance tuning, query optimization, indexing strategies, heterogeneous database migrations, backup and recovery.
- **Middleware & Networking**: Nginx, Apache HTTP Server, Apache Tomcat, JBoss Fuse, Envoy Proxy, DNS diagnostics, VPC security.
- **Automation & Scripting**: Bash, PowerShell, Python (FastAPI, ETL, Forensics), Rust, JavaScript/TypeScript.
- **Security & DevSecOps**: GCP Hardening, audit checklists, log forensics, compliance, InvGate, Zabbix, monitoring.

## Featured Projects
- **MuleRadarVcore**: Forensic vCores, capacity and FinOps radar for MuleSoft Anypoint Platform.
- **GCP Security Hardening Suite**: 33 automated audit checklists and hardening scripts for GCP infrastructure.
- **DBA Multi-Engine Migration Framework**: Zero-downtime and consistent cross-engine data migration tooling.
- **MuleSoft CloudHub Net-Tools**: Diagnostic forensics suite for network and DNS validation.
- **MarketRadar & VivyDisk**: Parallel high-throughput data and disk analysis engines built in Rust and DuckDB.
